article.title: Saudi Arabia turned down Israel’s offer to help fight Ansar Allah, but that could change soon
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: Mohammed bin Salman rejected Benjamin Netanyahu’s offer to help fight Ansar Allah in Yemen, but the Crown Prince may soon run out of options as Israel seeks to exploit Saudi concerns to its advantage.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
